insights.summary: H1 FY26 revenue fell 7% to ₹103 Cr as US tariffs cut exports and energy-meter demand weakened. The MD expects FY26 to close with 10-15% growth (₹220-230 Cr) at similar margins, and FY27 growth of 20-30% at a 16-18% EBITDA margin, led by alloys (₹40-70 Cr) and relays (₹20-50 Cr) as new capacity comes in. Rare-earth magnet assemblies stopped under China's export curbs; the Quantum Magnetics subsidiary plans to build to 5,000 tonnes (~₹3,700 Cr revenue) by FY30.
